cases.sentence: Гедеон отпустил всех ___ по шатрам, но оставил триста воинов, которым достались запасы пищи и боевые рога ушедших.
cases.explain: «остальных израильтян» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents, but retained the three hundred men; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

cases.sentence: Мадианитяне, амаликитяне и другие ___ наводнили долину, словно саранча.
cases.explain: «восточные народы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand which is on the seashore for multitude.

cases.explain: «израильский лагерь» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: It was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation, that he worshiped. Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said, “Arise, for Yahweh has delivered the army of Midian into your hand!”

cases.sentence: Разделив триста воинов на три отряда, он дал всем им в руки рога и ___ с факелами внутри.
cases.explain: «пустые сосуды» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.

cases.sentence: Войско бежало до самой Бет-Шитты к Церере, до ___ Авел-Мехолы близ Таббата.
cases.explain: «самой границы» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They blew the three hundred trumpets, and Yahweh set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel Meholah, by Tabbath.

cases.sentence: Еще они пленили двух ___, Орива и Зива.
cases.explain: «мадианских вождей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.
